findings.claim: Selected/unselected original 004513C0 status-setting instructions produce world status 0x00010010 or 0x00020000 respectively at the 0045148B original VCF call boundary; with the same emulated world state subsequently passed to original 004AD6F0 the low-order selection bit is preserved.
findings.limitations: The emulator harness, rather than the original CALL instruction in 004513C0, invokes 004AD6F0; basename/formatting service is intercepted. No claim of an uninterrupted native caller-to-callee instruction chain.

findings.claim: Selected GTSi and bus stock retail VCF/VDF resource loads run original VLOC 0x28 predicate, original child wrapper, original class binder 00461970 and runtime+0x398 writer; class-40 child pointer 27000800 exists after loader, with 9 source transform dwords checked exactly.
findings.limitations: Actual Windows heap/CRT and resource services are emulated; virtual pointer value is synthetic; no claim about real runtime address or full native OS process.

findings.claim: Unselected GTSi and bus status 0x00020000 cases complete original native VCF/VLOC load with NULL runtime+0x398, retaining 46/44 nodes instead of selected 47/45 and the same 912/856 GEO and 24/22 TMT binding counts.
findings.limitations: Unselected traces were fully completed scenarios of a multi-case Ghidra process later interrupted during another case; do not call entire interrupted process a successful full run.

findings.claim: With the native class-40 attachment the separately invoked original 00406AB0 default camera callback takes the post-null-guard branch at 00406B13 for GTSi and bus; without it original instructions follow null exit 00406DF4.
findings.limitations: Camera mode dispatch, further camera math/x87, clipping and pixel rendering not executed; harness explicitly supplies minimal active-entry pointer and invokes callback.

findings.claim: The original camera mathematics past 00406B13, complete native call continuity across the spawn CALL, class-40 attachment teardown and precise object+0x68 link semantics remain unresolved.
findings.limitations: Additional original-code execution and object lifetime traces required before source reconstruction or rendering claims.
